meta.name: Apharan 2018
meta.description: Rudra Srivastava, a senior inspector with Uttarakhand police is lured into kidnapping a young girl at her request. The plot begins as a simple plan to extort money in exchange for her release. When the chain of events go wrong and a series of lies unfold, he realizes that he is now a part of a deadly conspiracy. Will he be able to escape the outcome of his choices or become a victim of the web of lies?

videos.title: Ek Haseena Thi, Ek Dewaana Tha
videos.overview: Alcoholic and ex-cop Rudra Srivastava is sitting alone in a local bar. He comes across a beautiful lady who has an attractive proposition for him.

videos.title: Ek Hi Bhool
videos.overview: Rudra is adamant about meeting Anusha before kidnapping her. He sneaks into her college and risks his life.

videos.title: Le Jayenge Le Jayenge
videos.overview: Rudra reaches the wedding venue in disguise. He has very little time to kidnap Anusha before her father arrives.

videos.title: The Whole Thing Is That Baby Sabse Bada Rupaiya
videos.overview: Rudra tells Anusha to make the ransom call to her father. Tyagi and his security men try to trace Anusha’s location.

videos.title: Phiroti Ke Khel Main Sabka Katega
videos.overview: Tyagi arranges the ransom money. Rudra is happy that the job is well done. But he is about to get the shock of his life.

videos.title: Dekha Ek Khwab Toh Ye Silsile Hue
videos.overview: Rudra travels with the dead body of Anusha in a suitcase. He nearly gets caught. But the cops have already reached his home.

videos.title: Ae.. Ae.. Ae.. Phansa...
videos.overview: Rudra receives a warm welcome at the police station. He is the lead investigator on the Anusha Tyagi kidnapping case.

videos.title: Gumnaam Hai Koi Badnaam Hai Koi
videos.overview: Rudra gets a call from Madhu. But he doesn’t know her location yet. Meanwhile, he gets rid of Anusha’s body.

videos.title: Kati Patang
videos.overview: Rudra is called to the police station where Saxena accuses him of kidnapping Anusha. He claims he has evidence to prove.

videos.title: Aaj Kal Tere Mere Pyar Ke Charche Har Zuban Par
videos.overview: Rudra escapes from the police station. He runs all over the city from cops and Saxena’s men.

videos.title: Chahe Koi Mujhe Junglee Kahe
videos.overview: An injured Rudra is rescued by a stranger. He presents him with answers to questions that have been bothering him for a long time.

videos.title: Pyaar Mein Dil Pe Maar De Goli Le.. Le.. Meri Jaan
videos.overview: Rudra hunts down Anusha’s killers. He also finally meets the mysterious woman who planned this dangerous game of kidnapping.

videos.title: Rudra In Demand!
videos.overview: While the RAW is terrorised by Bikram Bahadur Shah, they decide to approach Rudra to handle the case. However, Rudra shockingly submits his resignation. Can Rudra be convinced to take up Bikram's case?

videos.title: Meet Rudra Aka Sumanth Mishra
videos.overview: Rudra accepts Ranjana's treatment offered by the authorities and changes his identity to Dr Sumanth Mishra and leaves for the mission. However, trouble arises when the case is suddenly deemed shut! What exactly happens?

videos.title: Rudra's Mission In Danger
videos.overview: Rudra's mission is on the brink of being aborted when his disguise is discovered by the officials. Later, Rudra learns a truth that leaves him in a state of complete shock!

videos.title: Rudra In A Sticky Situation
videos.overview: After Rudra learns of Bhandari's deceit, he is shocked when the latter threatens to harm Ranjana if he does not do as asked. Will Rudra go forward with Bhandari's orders?

videos.title: Rudra Faces Backlash
videos.overview: Ranjana lashes out at Rudra on learning that he tried to abandon her for indulging in drugs. And she also discloses that she was trying to save their marriage. How will Rudra handle the situation?

videos.title: A Shocker For Rudra
videos.overview: When Rudra is at his superior officer, Talwar's office, he is shocked to the core to learn that his doppelganger is still alive. Will Rudra share the news with Talwar?

videos.title: BBS In A Quandary
videos.overview: BBS learns that he is going to be subjected to a DNA test, so he asks his henchmen to bring Rudra back to India alive for the test. How will BBS execute the task?

videos.title: Rudra Gets Abducted
videos.overview: After BBS's henchmen abduct Rudra and hold him captive in a bunker, he tries to escape from captivity before time runs out. Will Rudra succeed in his attempt?

videos.title: Rudra Loses Control!
videos.overview: Rudra is shocked to learn about Ranjana's decision to divorce him and confronts her about it. However, he loses his cool when her mother slaps him in the face and commits a violent crime. What has he done?

videos.title: Rudra Learns The Truth!
videos.overview: Jagatap convinces Talwar that Rudra has turned against RAW and asks for his permission to bring him in. Elsewhere, Rudra's suspicion comes true as he finds out that he is a small part of a much larger plan.

videos.title: Rudra-Ranjana Are Reunited!
videos.overview: Ranjana learns that BBS is pretending to be Rudra and tries to run away from him. However, she bumps into the real Rudra in the process who engages in an epic battle with BBS. Who will come out alive?

meta.slogan: Yeh Apharan hai doston.. yahan sabka katega.. Dobara!
